params.name: accessToken
params.description: Will be passed through your lookup URL to get the user ID. Required if no `code`.

params.name: code
params.description: Will be passed to the OAuth token endpoint to get a token. Required if no `accessToken`.

params.name: redirect
params.description: Override where the user will navigate to after successfully logging in.

params.name: errorRedirect
params.description: If an error happens, redirects the user to this url, with at least query parameters `code`, `errorName` and `message`.

items.docs: Logs a user in. In this example, we call your lookup URL (let's say, `https://oauth.provider/user?t=<%= accessToken %>`) with the access token (`1234`). The lookup URL returns `{ id: 'abcd' }` in this case. We will match this `id` with the OAuthIdentity stored in the user information in our db. If everything checks out, the user is logged in and redirected to the home page.
